instruction.text: Hedis Vater berichtet von seiner Teilzeitbeschäftigung. Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: I started to work part-time a few months ago when Hedi's little sister Sara was born. It wasn't an easy decision, but I'm happy that I chose to try it out. Part-time work has many benefits. The main reason why I decided to work part-time was the time aspect. If I had a full-time job, I would have to work 40 hours a week. Thanks to my part-time job I only have to work 20 hours a week. As a result, I have more time than before for things that are important to me. I use the extra time for housework like doing laundry and washing the dishes. I also use the time to take care of Sara. Of course, I also have a little more time for myself and my hobbies like climbing and playing guitar. In other words, I have a better work-life balance because of my part-time job.

instruction.text: Hedis Vater berichtet von seiner Teilzeitbeschäftigung. Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

hint.text:
to be promoted – befördert werden
to bear responsibility – Verantwortung tragen
drawback – Nachteil
salary – Gehalt
hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to be promoted</voice> bedeutet befördert werden<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to bear responsibility</voice> bedeutet Verantwortung tragen <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>drawback</voice> bedeutet Nachteil<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>salary</voice> bedeutet Gehalt

atoms.text: Let's be honest, a part-time job isn't perfect. It has drawbacks too. One of them is the salary. Since I work less, I earn less money than before. That means I can't spend and save as much money as I would like to, but I can afford to work less because my wife works full-time. Moreover, I will probably not be promoted as easily because I am working less than some of my co-workers. However, I don't mind staying in my position since I don't want to bear even more responsibility. Maybe, I'll go back to a full-time job when Sara is older, but right now, I'll continue working part-time.
